highlights: OpenBot can read replies aloud on this computer, in 31 languages and ten voices.
Talk to an agent in the new Voice pane: speak, and the agent reads its reply aloud.
On Windows and Linux, OpenBot can keep running in the background from the system tray.
Launch OpenBot at login now works, and OpenBot keeps your account sign-in after a restart.
OpenCode agents continue in a new session when OpenCode cannot read the old one.
